newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wiener Staedtische says 1996 pretax down 7.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Wiener Staedtische says 1996 pretax down 7.4 pct.

text.p: Wiener Staedtische, one of Austria's leading insurers, said on Thursday its 1996 pretax profit fell 7.4 percent to 1.259 billion schillings.
In a statement released ahead of a news conference, the company declined to specify a reason for the drop, and said: "Wiener Staedtische had a very good pretax profit in 1996."

The company in April said it would raise its 1996 dividend on preference shares to 28 schillings from 25 schillings per share a year earlier. The company reported a 10.4 percent increase in gross premium income to 18.134 billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
